captions.detailed: This 3D model is a camera lens cap holder designed to slide onto a camera strap. It consists of concentric circular ring mounts of different diameters to hold multiple lens cap sizes, supported by an internal cross-member structure. Two rectangular buckle loops extend from opposite sides of the outer ring to guide the camera strap, with one loop featuring a small split opening for easy slip-on attachment.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric camera strap lens cap holder in OpenSCAD. The script should generate concentric circular mounts with securing lips for different lens cap diameters, and integrate two strap buckle loops on opposite sides, with an option to split one of the buckles for easy mounting.
captions.factory: The design is assembled by unioning a 'buckle' module and a 'capmount' module. The buckle is created using linear_extrude on a 2D layout that intersects an outer ring with a bounding rectangle, while subtracting a central clearance circle and an optional split gap square. The capmount module generates concentric rings with securing lips using linear_extrude on nested circle differences, and adds structural support with rotated square cross-members at 45-degree angles.
